detail.longDescription: How did Astro stay off my radar for this long? 💡 Using React or Next.js for personal projects always felt like using a sledgehammer to crack a nut - just too much overhead. Astro delivers the lightweight, fast setup I actually needed. Pure tunnel vision or habit? What tool recently simplified your tech stack? 🚀 # WebDev # AstroJS # Frontend # WebDevelopment
